chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him) regarding Mu'awiya
Treason and treachery, and its perpetrator is in the Hellfire

key_terms.مُعَاوِيَةَ: Mu'awiya ibn Abi Sufyan, the Umayyad caliph

ai.seo_question: What is Imam Ali's verdict on Mu'awiya's character and fate?
ai.summary: In this passage from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) critiques Mu'awiya’s usurpation of authority as a fundamental breach of covenant, reflecting the Shia scholarly view of his rule as a deviation from divine justice. By linking political treachery to eternal punishment, the Imam underscores the spiritual gravity of betraying the trust of the community and the Prophet’s lineage. This characterization serves as a theological basis for the legitimacy of the Ahl al-Bayt against the Umayyad caliphate.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Treason and treachery of Mu‘āwiyah and the fate of those guilty of treason
